rules.title: No saying “waffle”
rules.description: The word “waffle” is banned from the stage. Applies to transcribed speech (text) and the audio itself: the matching slice is muted in place.
rules.explanation: “Waffle” is our harmless stand-in for a banned word. Saying it mutes just that word so the joke around it survives.
examples: “So I had waffle for breakfast” → the word is muted

rules.title: Three-finger hand gesture
rules.description: Holding up exactly three fingers toward the camera. Our harmless stand-in for a rude hand gesture. The hand region is blurred in place.
rules.explanation: A three-finger gesture is blurred so the rest of the scene stays visible.
examples: Counting “one, two, three” on camera → hand blurred
Waving with three fingers up → blurred

rules.title: Touching your nose
rules.description: Touching your own nose on camera. Our harmless stand-in for an offensive visual. The face region is blurred in place.
rules.explanation: Nose-touching is blurred as our stand-in for visuals we cannot show in a demo.
examples: Scratching your nose mid-bit → region blurred
